name: MCtalent
summary:
MCtalent is a new virtual world where you can meet MC Engineering. Creativity and technology have created a place to recruit and hire talents.
With MCtalent, the job interview will no longer be just a moment of in-depth analysis of competencies and skills but will also represents a chance for candidates to live a futuristic, immersive, unforgettable and innovative experience.
We have designed the offices of MC Engineering, starting from the entrance where you will be greeted by the Vitruvian Man, common spa
